query:
SELECT 
  MONTH(pr.paymentDate) as month,
  CASE WHEN s.venue = '精英班道場' THEN 'elite' ELSE 'regular' END as class_type,
  COUNT(*) as payment_count,
  SUM(pr.amount) as total_amount
FROM paymentRecords pr
JOIN students s ON pr.studentId = s.id
WHERE pr.paymentDate >= '2026-01-01' 
  AND pr.paymentDate <= '2026-03-31'
  AND pr.status = 'confirmed'
GROUP BY MONTH(pr.paymentDate), class_type
ORDER BY month, class_type;
